user_input: Berapa total jumlah pasal yang merujuk ke Pasal 57 atau dirujuk oleh Pasal 57 dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 27 Tahun 2022?
reference_contexts: {'count': 33}
reference: Berdasarkan hasil kueri, total pasal-pasal yang merujuk ke atau dirujuk oleh Pasal 57 dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 adalah 33 pasal.
sql:
```sql
WITH pasal_57 AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM articles 
    WHERE article_number = '57' 
    AND regulation_id IN (
        SELECT id 
        FROM regulations 
        WHERE number = 27 
        AND year = 2022
    )
)
SELECT 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT from_article_id) 
        FROM article_relations 
        WHERE to_article_id IN (SELECT id FROM pasal_57)
    ) +
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT to_article_id) 
        FROM article_relations 
        WHERE from_article_id IN (SELECT id FROM pasal_57)
    ) AS total_pasal_terkait
```
response: Berdasarkan data yang tersedia, total jumlah pasal yang merujuk ke Pasal 57 atau dirujuk oleh Pasal 57 dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 adalah 36 pasal.

sql:
```sql
WITH original_article AS (
    SELECT a.id AS original_article_id
    FROM articles a
    JOIN regulations r ON a.regulation_id = r.id
    WHERE r.short_type = 'PERMENKOMINFO'
      AND r.number = '1'
      AND r.year = '2010'
      AND a.article_number = '70'
),
amendment_relations AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.to_article_id AS amended_article_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ar.to_article_id) AS amendment_count
    FROM article_relations ar
    WHERE 
        ar.from_article_id = (SELECT original_article_id FROM original_article)
        AND ar.relation_type = 'amandemen'
)

SELECT 
    a.article_number,
    a.text,
    r.title AS regulation_title,
    r.short_type,
    r.number,
    r.year,
    (SELECT amendment_count FROM amendment_relations) AS total_amendments
FROM articles a
JOIN regulations r ON a.regulation_id = r.id
JOIN article_relations ar ON a.id = ar.to_article_id
WHERE 
    ar.from_article_id = (SELECT original_article_id FROM original_article)
    AND ar.relation_type = 'amandemen'
```

```sql
WITH regulation_clusters AS (
    SELECT 
        rr.from_regulation_id AS base_regulation,
        r1.title AS base_regulation_title,
        rr.to_regulation_id AS related_regulation,
        r2.title AS related_regulation_title,
        rr.relation_type
    FROM 
        regulation_relations rr
    JOIN 
        regulations r1 ON rr.from_regulation_id = r1.id
    JOIN 
        regulations r2 ON rr.to_regulation_id = r2.id
    WHERE 
        rr.relation_type IN ('mengubah', 'melengkapi', 'merujuk', 'mengganti')
)

SELECT 
    base_regulation_title,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT related_regulation_title) AS related_regulations,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT relation_type) AS relation_types
FROM 
    regulation_clusters
GROUP BY 
    base_regulation_title
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT related_regulation) > 1
ORDER BY 
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT related_regulation), 1) DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE article_path AS (
    SELECT 
        ar.from_article_id AS start_article,
        ar.to_article_id AS end_article,
        ar.relation_type,
        ARRAY[ar.from_article_id, ar.to_article_id] AS path,
        1 AS depth
    FROM article_relations ar
    JOIN articles a1 ON ar.from_article_id = a1.id
    JOIN regulations r1 ON a1.regulation_id = r1.id
    JOIN articles a2 ON ar.to_article_id = a2.id
    JOIN regulations r2 ON a2.regulation_id = r2.id
    WHERE a1.article_number = '26'
      AND r1.short_type = 'UU'
      AND r1.number = 19
      AND r1.year = 2016
      AND a2.article_number = '9'
      AND r2.short_type = 'UU'
      AND r2.number = 27
      AND r2.year = 2022

    UNION

    SELECT 
        ar.from_article_id,
        ar.to_article_id,
        ar.relation_type,
        path || ar.to_article_id,
        depth + 1
    FROM article_relations ar
    JOIN article_path ap ON ar.from_article_id = ap.end_article
    WHERE ar.to_article_id != ALL(ap.path)
      AND depth < 5
)
SELECT 
    a1.article_number AS start_article_number,
    r1.title AS start_regulation,
    a2.article_number AS end_article_number,
    r2.title AS end_regulation,
    path,
    depth
FROM article_path ap
JOIN articles a1 ON ap.start_article = a1.id
JOIN regulations r1 ON a1.regulation_id = r1.id
JOIN articles a2 ON ap.end_article = a2.id
JOIN regulations r2 ON a2.regulation_id = r2.id
ORDER BY depth
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
WITH amended_regulations AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id, 
        r.title, 
        r.short_type,
        r.number,
        r.year,
        COUNT(rr.from_regulation_id) AS amendment_count
    FROM 
        regulations r
    JOIN 
        regulation_relations rr ON r.id = rr.to_regulation_id
    WHERE 
        rr.relation_type = 'mengubah'
        AND r.type ILIKE '%teknologi informasi%'

FROM
```

sql:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
    a."article_number",
    a."title",
    a."status",
    r."title" AS "regulation_title",
    r."number" AS "regulation_number",
    r."year" AS "regulation_year"
FROM
    "articles" a
JOIN
    "regulations" r ON a."regulation_id" = r."id"
JOIN
    "article_relations" ar ON a."id" = ar."from_article_id"
JOIN
    "articles" a_amended ON ar."to_article_id" = a_amended."id"
JOIN
    "regulations" r_amended ON a_amended."regulation_id" = r_amended."id"
WHERE
    r."short_type" = 'UU'
    AND r."number" = 11
    AND r."year" = 2008
    AND r_amended."short_type" = 'UU'
    AND r_amended."number" = 19
    AND r_amended."year" = 2016
    AND a."status" = 'ineffective'
```

Penyelenggaraan Jasa Telekomunikasi adalah kegiatan penyediaan dan/atau pelayanan Jasa Telekomunikasi yang memungkinkan terselenggaranya Telekomunikasi.
sql:
```sql
SELECT d.name, d.definition
FROM definitions d
JOIN regulations r ON d.regulation_id = r.id
WHERE r.short_type = 'PERMENKOMINFO'
  AND r.number = 5
  AND r.year = 2021
  AND d.name ILIKE '%Penyelenggaraan Jasa Telekomunikasi%'
```
